crossRefs.note: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the…
Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them…
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…
Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you?

translations.web: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

translations.kjv: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
